hero.subtitle: IT Engineer / Cloud & DevOps
hero.desc: IT System Administrator with 2+ years managing enterprise infrastructure for 150–500 users. M.Sc. Data Science student at FAU Erlangen. Building toward Cloud/DevOps engineering. Open to relocation worldwide.
about.p1: I'm an IT System Administrator currently working at **ABL GmbH** in Lauf, Germany, where I independently manage the full IT environment for 150–500 users — from Microsoft 365 and Active Directory administration to endpoint deployment, network infrastructure, and hardware asset management.
about.p2: Alongside my professional work, I'm pursuing a **Master's in Data Science** at Friedrich-Alexander-Universität (FAU) Erlangen-Nürnberg, where I work on machine learning, AI systems, and data engineering — most recently presenting research on self-supervised learning for dysarthric speech recognition at the Pattern Recognition Lab.
about.p3: I'm actively building Cloud and DevOps skills — learning **Azure, Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes** — targeting roles that bridge IT infrastructure with modern cloud engineering. I'm fully open to relocation worldwide for the right opportunity.
contact.heading: Let's work together
contact.text: I'm actively looking for full-time IT, Cloud/DevOps, or Data Engineering roles worldwide. I'm open to relocation and excited to join an international team. Drop me an email or connect on LinkedIn — I respond within 24 hours.
